title.en: Magdalenian bison molded onto ceiling bosses (full-scale replica)
title.zh: 借岩顶凸起塑形的马格德林野牛（等比例复制顶棚）

alt.en: Red ochre and black charcoal bison painted across curving limestone reliefs on a cave ceiling replica.
alt.zh: 在洞顶复制岩面的起伏凸起上，以红赭石与木炭绘制的野牛形象。

caption.en: Full-scale replica of the Great Ceiling of Altamira (original c. 14,500–12,000 BCE), Anthropos Pavilion, Moravian Museum, Brno.

interpretation.en: Paleolithic painters wrapped pigment around natural rock bulges so torchlight gave the bison volume; modern replicas protect the fragile cave microclimate.
interpretation.zh: 旧石器时代画师顺着天然岩突涂敷颜料，借火把摇曳赋予野牛立体感；现代等比例复制品则用于保护脆弱的原洞微气候。

alt.zh: 蒙特港附近蒙特维德考古保护区的林地湿地形貌与遗址保护设施。

caption.zh: 智利南部蒙特港附近的蒙特维德国家古迹遗址，饱水泥炭层在此保存了约公元前12500年的有机遗存。

alt.en: A massive circular tower of undressed fieldstones exposed inside a deep archaeological trench at Jericho.
alt.zh: 耶利哥深层探方中揭露出的巨型未琢石块圆形石塔。

caption.en: Round stone tower (c. 8000 BCE) with internal twenty-two-step stair, excavated at Tell es-Sultan, Jericho.
caption.zh: 耶利哥苏丹丘发掘出土的圆形石塔（约公元前8000年），内部砌有二十二级石阶。

interpretation.en: Built centuries before pottery, the 8.5-meter tower demanded coordinated quarrying and collective maintenance beside Ain es-Sultan spring.
interpretation.zh: 这座高约8.5米的石塔早于制陶术数百年建成，反映出苏丹泉畔社群在采石与公共维护上的高度协作。

title.zh: 贾湖新石器时代七孔鹤骨笛

alt.en: A slender golden-brown hollow bird bone drilled with a neat row of finger holes in a museum case.
alt.zh: 博物馆展柜中一根细长黄褐色中空禽骨，正面钻有一排整齐指孔。

caption.en: Playable flute carved from a red-crowned crane ulna, Jiahu site, Wuyang, Henan, c. 7000–5700 BCE. Henan Museum.
caption.zh: 以丹顶鹤尺骨钻孔制成的可吹奏骨笛，河南舞阳贾湖遗址出土（约公元前7000—前5700年），河南博物院藏。

interpretation.en: Fine tuning marks beside the finger holes show that early Huai River rice-and-foraging villagers calibrated pitch deliberately.
interpretation.zh: 指孔旁的微调刻痕表明，淮河上游早期稻作与采集村落已能有意识地校准音高。

caption.en: Gold ornaments and ritual appliqués from Grave 36, Varna Chalcolithic Necropolis, Bulgaria, c. 4600–4400 BCE. Varna Archaeological Museum.

alt.zh: 麦加近郊石质山丘间蜿蜒延伸的历史引水渠砌石墙体。

caption.en: Surviving masonry section of the Ayn Zubayda water canal endowed by Zubayda bint Jaʿfar in the early ninth century CE near Mecca.
caption.zh: 麦加近郊留存的“祖拜达泉”引水渠石砌渠段，由祖拜达·宾特·贾法尔于九世纪初捐资兴建。

caption.en: The Cyrus Cylinder, baked clay foundation deposit from Babylon, c. 539–538 BCE. British Museum (BM 90920).

alt.zh: 长方形砂岩石碑上部刻有两行乌加里特字母楔形文字。

caption.en: Kondō (Golden Hall) and five-story pagoda in the Western Precinct of Hōryū-ji, Ikaruga, Nara Prefecture, reconstructed late seventh century CE.
caption.zh: 奈良县斑鸠町法隆寺西院伽蓝金堂与五重塔，重建于七世纪末。

alt.en: Lime-coated bark-paper folio painted in red and black with Maya glyph blocks, bar-and-dot numerals and deity figures.
alt.zh: 涂白树皮纸折页上以朱黑两色绘写玛雅文字块、横点数字与神祇形象。

caption.en: Folio from the Postclassic Maya Dresden Codex (c. twelfth–fifteenth century), painted on amatl fig-bark paper. SLUB Dresden.
caption.zh: 后古典期玛雅《德累斯顿抄本》树皮纸彩绘书页（约十二至十五世纪），萨克森州立暨大学图书馆藏。

alt.en: Calligraphic Portuguese legal decree surrounded by floral painted borders and signed by Princess Imperial Isabel.
alt.zh: 绘有花卉彩饰边框的葡萄牙文书法法令原件，下方署帝国摄政伊莎贝尔公主签名。

interpretation.en: Two terse articles ended legal slavery across the Americas’ last slaveholding empire after decades of quilombo flight, courtroom suits and mass strikes.
interpretation.zh: 在逃亡奴聚落抗争、废奴诉讼与大规模罢工持续冲击数十年后，短短两条法文终结了美洲最后一个蓄奴帝国的法定奴隶制。

alt.en: Sixteenth-century woodcut showing steep conical Cerro Rico laced with mine paths above clustered colonial buildings.
alt.zh: 十六世纪木刻版画，绘陡峭圆锥形富饶山体上交错的矿道及山脚密集的矿镇建筑。

caption.en: Woodcut of Cerro Rico de Potosí from Pedro Cieza de León’s Parte primera de la chrónica del Perú (Seville, 1553).
caption.zh: 佩德罗·谢萨·德莱昂《秘鲁编年史》第一部（1553年塞维利亚印本）中的波托西富饶山木刻插图。

interpretation.en: Published just eight years after Spanish registration of the lodes, the woodcut records the Andean peak whose silver financed global trade from Manila to Seville.
interpretation.zh: 刊印于矿脉登记后仅八年，这幅版画定格了以白银驱动马尼拉至塞维利亚全球贸易的安第斯矿山。

caption.en: Preserved stone-paved section of the Qhapaq Ñan (Andean road system) east of the Cordillera Blanca, Peru.

alt.en: Black-and-white 1885 photograph of bearded railway directors in top coats crowded around Donald Smith swinging a spike maul.

caption.en: Alexander Ross, Donald A. Smith driving the Last Spike of the Canadian Pacific Railway at Craigellachie, British Columbia, 7 November 1885. Library and Archives Canada.
caption.zh: 亚历山大·罗斯摄《1885年11月7日不列颠哥伦比亚省克雷格拉希唐纳德·史密斯砸下加拿大太平洋铁路最后一颗道钉》，加拿大图书与档案馆藏。

interpretation.zh: 铁路高管在镜头前合影留念，而开凿弗雷泽峡谷险峻隧道的数千名华工却被排除在画面之外。

title.zh: 欧洲核子研究中心蒂姆·伯纳斯-李首台万维网服务器（NeXTcube）

alt.en: Black cube workstation and monitor bearing a hand-lettered sticker warning not to power the server down.
alt.zh: 黑色立方体工作站主机与显示器，机箱贴有手写红字“此机为服务器，切勿关机”标签。

caption.en: NeXTcube workstation used by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN in 1990 to host info.cern.ch, the first HTTP server and web browser.
caption.zh: 1990年蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在欧洲核子研究中心运行首个HTTP服务器（info.cern.ch）与网页浏览器的NeXTcube工作站。

interpretation.en: Berners-Lee’s handwritten warning—“This machine is a server. DO NOT POWER IT DOWN!!”—shows how the entire early Web depended on one desktop box.

title.en: Mohandas Gandhi striding toward Dandi on the March 1930 Salt March
title.zh: 1930年3月甘地率众徒步前往丹迪开展食盐进军

alt.en: Black-and-white 1930 photograph of Gandhi in homespun khadi walking briskly with a bamboo staff beside fellow marchers.
alt.zh: 1930年黑白纪实照片，身着土布卡迪的甘地手持竹杖与同行者快步行进。

caption.en: Mohandas K. Gandhi during the 385-kilometer Salt Satyagraha from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi, March–April 1930.
caption.zh: 1930年3—4月莫罕达斯·甘地自萨巴尔马蒂道场徒步385公里赴海滨丹迪开展“食盐非暴力抵抗”途中。

interpretation.en: Boiling untaxed sea salt turned an everyday household necessity into mass civil disobedience that drew tens of thousands — including women leaders — into anti-colonial protest.
interpretation.zh: 在海滩自煮无税海盐将日常生计必需品转化为全民非暴力不合作行动，动员包括众多女性领袖在内的数万民众投入反殖抗争。

alt.zh: 手写英文宪法序言，四周绘有莲花、瑞兽与几何纹样的金彩装饰边框。

caption.en: Original Preamble folio of the Constitution of India, calligraphed by Prem Behari Narain Raizada and illuminated by Beohar Rammanohar Sinha at Santiniketan (1949–1950).

interpretation.en: Adopted by the Constituent Assembly under B. R. Ambedkar’s drafting leadership, the republic’s founding charter enacted universal adult suffrage across a newly partitioned subcontinent.
interpretation.zh: 在安培多尔主持起草、制宪会议审议通过的这部共和国根本大法中，新独立的次大陆确立了普遍成人选举权与宪政框架。

alt.en: Stepped earthen pyramid studded with projecting wooden toron scaffolding beams rising above a Sahelian courtyard.

caption.en: Tomb complex built at Gao around 1495 by Askia Muhammad I after his pilgrimage to Mecca and Cairo.

alt.zh: 泛黄手写毛利文文书书页，下方排列着多位毛利酋长签名与面部刺青纹样画押。

caption.en: First sheet of He Whakaputanga o te Rangatiratanga o Nu Tireni (Declaration of Independence of the United Tribes of New Zealand), signed at Waitangi beginning 28 October 1835. Archives New Zealand.

title.zh: 1976年双体远洋航海独木舟“霍库莱阿号”首航归来

alt.en: 1976 color photograph of the twin-hulled Polynesian canoe Hōkūleʻa under crab-claw sails entering Hawaiian waters.
alt.zh: 1976年彩色纪实照片，扬起蟹钳帆的波利尼西亚双体航海舟“霍库莱阿号”驶入夏威夷海域。

caption.en: Voyaging canoe Hōkūleʻa arriving in Honolulu on 26 August 1976 after completing her round-trip maiden voyage between Hawaiʻi and Tahiti. Photograph by Phil Uhl.
caption.zh: 1976年8月26日“霍库莱阿号”完成夏威夷与塔希提往返首航抵达檀香山，菲尔·乌尔（Phil Uhl）摄。

interpretation.en: Guided outbound by Satawalese master navigator Mau Piailug without instruments, the 1976 voyage proved intentional Polynesian wayfinding and sparked a Pacific cultural renaissance.
interpretation.zh: 去程由萨塔瓦尔领航大师毛·皮艾卢格不借仪器凭星象海浪引航成功，有力证实了波利尼西亚人的有意识远洋航行并点燃太平洋文化复兴。

caption.en: Paved courtyard and basalt ahu platform of Marae Taputapuātea at Opoa, Raʻiātea, Society Islands.

caption.en: Volcanic water system at Budj Bim (Mount Eccles) in Gunditjmara Country, southwestern Victoria, Australia.
caption.zh: 澳大利亚维多利亚州西南部贡迪杰马拉人世代经营的布吉必姆火山水系景观。

interpretation.en: Gunditjmara engineers shaped basalt lava flows into stone weirs, channels and holding ponds to harvest kooyang (short-finned eels) for over 6,600 years.
